content.text: Are there any agents who haven't verified their email addresses yet?
Let me pull up the manual to find the right function for checking email verification status.{{TOOL:compliance_verification}}
I need to run a compliance check specifically for agents with unverified email addresses.{{TOOL:check_compliance}}

The compliance check returned too many results — there appear to be a large number of agents with unverified emails. Let me try a different approach. I can use the aggregation reporting function to get a summary count instead of the full list of unverified agents.

Let me pull up that manual to see how to structure a more focused query.{{TOOL:aggregation_reporting}}

I can use aggregation reporting to get a count of agents grouped by their email verification status. This will give us a summary without overwhelming the context window.{{TOOL:generate_aggregation_report}}

context_diary: User asked about agents with unverified email addresses. I ran an aggregation report and found 762 out of 1,498 agents (51%) have unverified emails, while 736 have verified.
